messages:
jen: Customer reports CSV export missing two days in a 7-day range. Account: acct_9b2f. They say dashboard shows tokens for 2026-03-04 and 2026-03-05 but the CSV only contains 03/01-03/03 and 03/06-03/07. Export run: 2026-03-08T10:12:03Z via /v1/usage/export (UI).

sanjay: Sorry for the trouble. Can you paste a tiny CSV snippet (first ~10 rows) and confirm the export time + timezone? Also did they use the API or the Console export?

jen: Console export. Snippet (redacted):
```csv
date,customer_id,tokens_used
2026-03-01,acct_9b2f,1245
2026-03-02,acct_9b2f,980
2026-03-03,acct_9b2f,1302
2026-03-06,acct_9b2f,1501
2026-03-07,acct_9b2f,1100
```

jen: They also attached the export file name: usage_export_1763459999_part-0.csv (looks like single file). Customer expects rows for 03/04 and 03/05.

sanjay: Thanks. A couple quick repro checks while I dig in: can you ask customer to run the API export with explicit start/end and timezone like:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/export" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -d '{"start":"2026-03-01","end":"2026-03-08","tz":"UTC"}'
```
This helps rule out UI-one-off chunking. Also sending the admin export job id would help; UI footer sometimes shows it.

elaine: I looked at the backfill logs for acct_9b2f. There was a backfill run triggered 2026-03-04T02:07:12Z that partially failed with a shard retry. The retry ran at 2026-03-04T02:20:43Z and marked overlapping shard ranges as de-duplicated. There's a known edge case where if a retry flagged a shard as "already applied" but the checkpoint pointer moved, we can drop 48-hour windows. I'm going to pull logs for the export job id once you provide it.

infra-logs-bot: log snippet for job=usage-export-1763459999: 
```
2026-03-04T02:07:12Z INFO export:start job=usage-export-1763459999 account=acct_9b2f range=2026-03-01..2026-03-08 shard=15/32
2026-03-04T02:07:14Z ERROR export:worker job=usage-export-1763459999 shard=15 err=ShardRangeSkipped(reason=empty-range-after-trim)
2026-03-04T02:20:43Z INFO export:retry job=usage-export-1763459999 shard=15/32 status=marked-duplicate
```

harper: I can re-run the export backfill for this account manually. I'll run the regen job with force-apply to ensure duplicate detection doesn't skip. Command I'm going to run:
```bash
admin-cli usage backfill --account acct_9b2f --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-08 --force-apply --reason "support: missing-days CSV"
```
I'll post the new export when done.

billing-bot: Backfill regen queued: job=regen-1763460205 owner=harper account=acct_9b2f

jen: Customer also says invoice for Mar 1-7 shows 12,800 tokens in billing dashboard but CSV sums to 7,128 tokens (because of missing days). They need the CSV to match invoice for audit. Any ETA?

olivia: @sanjay @elaine we should add a guard that compares export row count / token sum vs the canonical billing rollup for the same range and alert when they differ by >5%. This keeps customers from getting mismatched files. Adding to next sprint backlog unless this is a high severity repeat.

sanjay: +1. For this thread: regen started, I'll verify the regenerated CSV against both dashboard and billing-aggregates. If mismatch persists I'll escalate to billing-engineering for a fix in dedupe logic. ETA for regen result ~30-45m.

jen: Customer confirmed they can wait for the regen. I'll update them with your ETA.

harper: regen finished 2026-03-08T10:50:12Z. New file: usage_export_1763460205_part-0.csv. Quick diff shows two rows added for 2026-03-04 and 2026-03-05.

sanjay: Verified sums: CSV tokens=12812, billing rollup=12800 (12 token rounding drift due to tokenization changes) — within tolerance. Marking ticket as resolved pending customer's sign-off.

jen: Customer acknowledged and will confirm tomorrow when accounting re-checks. Marking as pending external confirmation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
